Example Corp Q2 earnings call excerpt (fixture)

CEO: Demand was stable; we did not highlight AI servers as a primary growth driver this quarter.
CFO: Near-term outlook is cautious; we reiterated cost discipline.
Gross margin held flat sequentially with limited pricing pressure commentary.
CapEx plans were unchanged; dividends stay stable.
Key risks include supply-chain lead times; customer concentration was not emphasized.
No formal numeric guidance range was stated for the full year.
